issue: `seedTicks()` only writes symbols that are missing, so later polling snapshots never refresh `price`/`changePct` once a symbol has been seeded; after first load or an SSE outage, Tape rows can display stale quotes indefinitely.
fix: Track freshness/source per symbol and overwrite snapshot values when the poll is newer instead of skipping existing entries.

issue: The command-palette actions `a-flatten` and `a-scan` open confirmation dialogs whose `onConfirm` handlers are empty, so an operator can confirm critical actions and nothing is ever sent to the backend.
fix: Wire those confirmations to the same `api.control.flattenAll` and `api.control.triggerScan` flows used elsewhere.

issue: `SymbolDrawer` only renders when `selectedRow` exists in `data.rows`, so clicking a symbol from Morning Prep or Paper Book silently fails whenever that symbol is not in the cockpit snapshot.
fix: Load drawer data by symbol independently of `rows`, or provide a symbol-only fallback model instead of requiring a cockpit row.

issue: `computeRail()` treats any numeric `stop`/`entry`/`target` as valid and never enforces `stop < entry < target`, so reversed or otherwise invalid plans render a plausible-looking rail instead of degrading to `no plan`.
fix: Reject non-monotonic trade levels (and optionally `trade_plan_valid === false`) by returning `ok: false`.

issue: The client defaults to `http://localhost:8001` and `get()` builds `new URL(API_BASE + path)` without a same-origin fallback, which breaks HTTPS/production deployments via mixed-content errors or relative `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` values.
fix: Default to a relative API base and resolve relative URLs against `window.location.origin` before calling `fetch`/`EventSource`.

issue: `paper()` normalizes unknown JSON with type assertions like `(p.entry_price as number)` instead of parsing, so stringified numerics from the backend can corrupt `open_pl` math and price formatting while TypeScript hides the mismatch.
fix: Convert every numeric field with `Number(...)` plus null/NaN guards before building `PaperPosition`.

issue: The fallback phase heuristic uses only the ET hour, so 09:00-09:29 ET is mislabeled as `live` when market metadata is absent even though the regular cash session has not opened.
fix: Use minute-level session boundaries (09:30/16:00 ET) or require explicit backend phase metadata.

issue: Only symbol results close the palette; selecting a view or action command leaves the palette open over the new view or confirmation dialog.
fix: Wrap every command result so `onClose()` runs before executing `r.run()`.

issue: `api.paper()` always returns `equity: null`, but `Cockpit` passes `paper.data?.equity` into `TopBar`, so the header's paper-equity display can never show a real value.
fix: Populate `PaperResponse.equity` from backend data or derive the latest equity from `/api/paper/equity-curve` before passing it to `TopBar`.

issue: If `lightweight-charts` fails to import or initialize, the `catch` block swallows the error but the component still renders only an empty host div instead of the documented unavailable-state message.
fix: Track chart initialization failure in state and render `EmptyChart` when setup throws.

issue: When there are no results, pressing ArrowDown sets `active` to `-1` via `Math.min(a + 1, results.length - 1)`, leaving the palette in an invalid selection state.
fix: Skip arrow-key updates when `results.length === 0` and clamp `active` to the valid range `0..results.length - 1`.
